mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect 70 degrees with partly cloudy skies near the Verona Public Library and a moderate air quality index of 78.

The City of Verona has announced that the Plan Commission will meet on November 4th to review several proposals, including the final plat for Ardent Glen and various site plans. Additionally, property tax bills will be mailed by December 15th.
Today you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run. Tomorrow, make sure to visit the Dane County Farmer's Market or catch more live music at Paddy Mac's.
On October 15th, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after reports of dangerous driving behavior while students were on board.
Our Culver's location is currently closed for the night. Please join us tomorrow starting at 10:00 AM to enjoy the new flavor of the day, Andes Mint Avalanche.
